# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

Please don't open a public issue. Use **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/ThirtyFile/ThirtyFile/security/advisories/new)** instead, so the problem can be fixed before it is public.

Include what you did, what happened, and the version: the image tag you run, or the output of `docker exec thirtyfile thirtyfile --version`.

## Supported versions

Fixes are released for the newest version only. Upgrading is described in [Upgrade and backup](https://thirtyfile.github.io/ThirtyFile/docs/backup.html).
